text_block_list.text:
The day after a day off.
Upon arriving at the Trainer's office—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—Ah. S-Sorry.
I only meant to rest on the sofa for a little bit...
choice_data_list: Were you able to sleep well last night?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Um. I was gazing at my moss terrarium and lost track of time; it's already quite late.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's a type of gardening where you grow moss inside glass containers,
and it's so delightful watching it grow day by day~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
However, I will be mindful of my lack
of sleep from now on... *yawn*...

Grass Wonder, who seems to have stayed up late,
didn't appear to be very well-rested.
